study type: secondary analysis of cross-sectional health facility assessments
cohort: 59 public health facilities in Afghanistan expected to provide comprehensive emergency obstetric and newborn care
finding: While the provision of assisted vaginal deliveries increased, the overall readiness to provide emergency obstetric and newborn care in Afghan health facilities declined between 2010 and 2016, with a decrease in the availability of essential medications and the number of midwives on duty.
mod_finding: The availability of Cesarean delivery did not change significantly between 2010 and 2016.
cross-section timing: December 2009 to February 2010 and May 2016 to January 2017
